lede: The gondola is front and center this week — the Gondola Leadership Committee meets Monday, July 28, for what looks like a genuinely substantive session covering project history, Capital Investment Grant funding commitments, and a project update, with background and history listed as an action item. The Town Council also holds a special public hearing Sunday on KOTO's liquor permit for its Live at the Drive event at 207 N Pine on July 30. Elsewhere, the week fills out with the Dual Challenge climate talks, Market on the Plaza, and a free Jungle Book performance at the Sheridan to close things out.
